source_facts: Upstream d64e35a fixes the coreutils-9.5 mcel_scan pointer loop in find_field, which computes a byte length for later memcmp.
Exact old source tar is the same 8.32 tar as inspected, SHA4458d8de7849df44ccab15e16b1548b285224dbba5f08fac070c1c0e0bcc4cfa.
Exact old vendor i18n patch differs overall from newer 43; its src/uniq.c patch body is independently compared and identical, not assumed from version.
Only coreutils-i18n.patch among all exact-old vendor patch files changes src/uniq.c. Old spec applies it through unconditional %autopatch -p1.
find_field_multi advances a bounded pos through skip_fields/skip_chars with MBCHAR_TO_WCHAR and returns lp+pos; it does not contain mcel_scan or the defective fixed-lp/advancing-ep loop.
The -w comparison remains the original different function, clipping oldlen and newlen by check_chars before equality/length-checked memcmp; no expanding multibyte check_chars byte length exists.
Actual usr/bin/coreutils and uniq dispatch script match the retained installed x86_64 RPM header file digests; complete 70 ELF runtime headers independently identify x86_64.
